hypothesis: compute_trip_end_utc hardcodes Asia/Tokyo UTC+9, causing trips in other timezones (e.g., America/New_York EDT or Europe/London) to calculate trip end timestamps with up to 13-17 hours of drift, prematurely freezing or misaligning time locks.
unlock_trip_capsules_early lacks a temporal boundary guard ensuring it is only triggered during the final day of the trip in destination local time, allowing premature unveiling on Day 1 or Day 2.

submit_trip_capsule allows overwriting existing entries even after is_capsule_unlocked is true, creating a post-unveil tampering vulnerability where a user modifies their diary after reading companions' unsealed notes.
